name: Google Chirp 3
blurb: Google Cloud’s latest multilingual STT model — streaming, batch, diarisation, language detection, and adaptation.
about: Chirp 3 is Google Cloud’s latest multilingual ASR-specific generative model, available through Speech-to-Text API V2. It supports more than 85 languages and locales across streaming, short-form and batch recognition, with speaker diarisation, automatic language detection, speech adaptation for custom vocabulary, and built-in denoising.

The service is cloud-only and currently priced at $0.016 per audio minute for Speech-to-Text V2. Chirp 3 is not present in the current cleaned Open ASR result export, so no leaderboard WER is shown here. Prices and regional feature availability can change — check the Google Cloud documentation before deployment.
install:
pip install google-cloud-speech

# Speech-to-Text V2 model identifier: chirp_3
